content: Unlike natural images, different elements indocument images can vary significantly inscale, such as one-line title and whole-page ta-ble. To handle this scale-varying challenge, weintroduce a hierarchical architecture called GL-CRM, which consists of two main components:the Controllable Receptive Module (CRM) andthe Global-to-Local Design (GL). CRM flexi-bly extracts and integrates features with mul-tiple scales and granularities, while GL archi-tecture features a hierarchical perception pro-cess from global context (whole-page scale), tosub-block areas (medium-scale), and finally lo-cal semantics information.
